title: Data Analyst Mastery Roadmap
summary: Deepen your analytical expertise, build best‑practice workflows, and create professional‑grade portfolio pieces. By the end you’ll turn raw data into actionable insights and be ready for full‑time roles or client work.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Establish core data handling and statistical thinking.

milestones.title: Spreadsheet fluency
milestones.outcome: You can clean, transform, and visualize data efficiently in Excel or Google Sheets.

tasks.title: Complete Excel data‑cleaning tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the freeCodeCamp Excel Basics course and practice cleaning a sample sales sheet.

tasks.title: Build a pivot‑table report
tasks.description: Create a pivot table summarizing monthly revenue by region using the sample dataset.

tasks.title: Practice conditional formatting
tasks.description: Apply color scales to highlight top‑performing products in the sheet.

tasks.title: Reflect on spreadsheet limits
tasks.description: Write a brief note on scenarios where spreadsheets become insufficient.

milestones.title: SQL fundamentals
milestones.outcome: You can query relational databases to extract, filter, and aggregate data.

tasks.title: Read SQL SELECT guide on W3Schools
tasks.description: Study the SELECT syntax, WHERE clause, and basic functions.

tasks.title: Run queries on a public SQLite DB
tasks.description: Download the Chinook sample database and answer five practice questions.

tasks.title: Build a sales summary view
tasks.description: Write a query that returns total sales per month and product category.

tasks.title: Connect with a SQL community
tasks.description: Join the r/SQL subreddit and introduce yourself, asking a question about joins.

milestones.title: Intro to Python & pandas
milestones.outcome: You can load, clean, and explore data programmatically with pandas.

tasks.title: Complete pandas basics on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Watch the video series and run the accompanying notebooks.

tasks.title: Import a CSV and inspect data
tasks.description: Write a script that loads a public dataset and prints summary statistics.

tasks.title: Build a data‑cleaning function
tasks.description: Create a reusable function that handles missing values and type conversion.

tasks.title: Reflect on code readability
tasks.description: Write a short note on naming conventions and comments you used.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop analytical, statistical, and visualization capabilities.

milestones.title: Statistical reasoning
milestones.outcome: You can design experiments and interpret results with confidence intervals and p‑values.

tasks.title: Study hypothesis testing on Khan Academy
tasks.description: Complete the module on t‑tests and chi‑square tests.

tasks.title: Practice A/B test calculations
tasks.description: Using a sample dataset, compute lift, confidence interval, and significance.

tasks.title: Build an experiment report template
tasks.description: Create a markdown template that captures hypothesis, method, results, and conclusions.

tasks.title: Reflect on assumptions
tasks.description: List three assumptions underlying your A/B test analysis.

milestones.title: Data visualisation
milestones.outcome: You can craft clear, interactive charts that highlight key insights.

tasks.title: Read Chart Design guide on DataVizCatalog
tasks.description: Understand best practices for choosing chart types.

tasks.title: Create a bar chart in Tableau Public
tasks.description: Download Tableau Public, connect to a sample dataset, and build a sales bar chart.

tasks.title: Practice interactive filters
tasks.description: Add a date filter to the Tableau dashboard and test its behavior.

tasks.title: Connect with a visualization forum
tasks.description: Post your Tableau dashboard on the Tableau Community Forum for feedback.

milestones.title: Storytelling with data
milestones.outcome: You can structure narratives that turn analysis into actionable recommendations.

tasks.title: Study storytelling framework on Storytelling with Data book
tasks.description: Read the first two chapters (available summary online) and note key steps.

tasks.title: Draft a slide deck outline
tasks.description: Create a 5‑slide outline for a sales performance story using a mock dataset.

tasks.title: Practice concise captions
tasks.description: Write one‑sentence captions for each chart you created earlier.

tasks.title: Reflect on audience needs
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how you would adapt the story for executives vs. analysts.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Apply your skills to real‑world portfolio projects.

milestones.title: Sales dashboard project
milestones.outcome: You deliver an interactive dashboard that tracks key sales metrics.

tasks.title: Select a public sales dataset
tasks.description: Find a dataset on Kaggle or data.gov that includes dates, products, and revenue.

tasks.title: Clean and model data in pandas
tasks.description: Write a script that handles missing values, creates date hierarchies, and aggregates monthly sales.

tasks.title: Design dashboard in Power BI
tasks.description: Build a Power BI report with filters, KPI cards, and trend charts.

tasks.title: Write a project summary
tasks.description: Compose a one‑page write‑up describing objectives, methodology, and insights.

tasks.title: Publish to portfolio site
tasks.description: Upload the Power BI embed link and write‑up to your personal website or GitHub Pages.

milestones.title: A/B test analysis write‑up
milestones.outcome: You produce a professional report that explains experiment design and results.

tasks.title: Obtain an A/B test dataset
tasks.description: Download a sample conversion dataset from Kaggle.

tasks.title: Perform statistical analysis in Python
tasks.description: Use pandas and scipy to calculate lift, confidence interval, and p‑value.

tasks.title: Create visual results in matplotlib
tasks.description: Plot conversion rates with error bars for control and variant.

tasks.title: Write a findings report
tasks.description: Draft a markdown report covering hypothesis, method, results, and recommendations.

tasks.title: Get peer feedback
tasks.description: Share the report on r/datascience for critique and incorporate suggestions.

milestones.title: Cohort retention report
milestones.outcome: You deliver a cohort analysis that reveals user retention trends over time.

tasks.title: Extract user event data
tasks.description: Use SQL to pull sign‑up and activity timestamps from a sample database.

tasks.title: Build retention matrix in pandas
tasks.description: Write code that groups users by signup month and calculates weekly retention percentages.

tasks.title: Visualise retention heatmap
tasks.description: Create a seaborn heatmap showing cohort retention decay.

tasks.title: Summarise insights in a slide
tasks.description: Prepare a single slide highlighting key retention patterns and actions.

tasks.title: Reflect on analysis limitations
tasks.description: Note three data quality or methodological limits of your cohort study.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced techniques, professional habits, and job‑search readiness.

milestones.title: Advanced SQL & performance
milestones.outcome: You can write optimized queries and use window functions for complex analysis.

tasks.title: Study window functions on Mode Analytics blog
tasks.description: Read the guide and understand ROW_NUMBER, LAG, and cumulative sums.

tasks.title: Optimize a slow query
tasks.description: Take a query from your sales dashboard and rewrite it for better performance.

tasks.title: Build a reusable query library
tasks.description: Create a set of parameterized SQL snippets stored in a Git repo.

tasks.title: Reflect on query debugging
tasks.description: Write a short note on tools you used to profile query execution.

tasks.title: Connect with a DB admin community
tasks.description: Join the DBAdmins Slack channel and introduce yourself.

milestones.title: Python for automation & reproducibility
milestones.outcome: You can automate data pipelines and ensure analyses are reproducible.

tasks.title: Learn Jupyter Notebook best practices on nbviewer
tasks.description: Read the tips for structuring notebooks and using markdown cells.

tasks.title: Create a data pipeline script
tasks.description: Write a Python script that extracts, transforms, and loads data daily using cron syntax.

tasks.title: Practice version control with Git
tasks.description: Initialize a repo for your pipeline, commit changes, and push to GitHub.

tasks.title: Reflect on reproducibility checklist
tasks.description: Draft a checklist covering data sources, code, environment, and documentation.

tasks.title: Connect with Python automation forum
tasks.description: Share your pipeline on the r/learnpython subreddit for feedback.

milestones.title: Job/Client readiness
milestones.outcome: You can present your portfolio, interview confidently, and negotiate offers.

tasks.title: Polish portfolio website
tasks.description: Add project screenshots, descriptions, and links to live dashboards on your site.

tasks.title: Prepare STAR interview stories
tasks.description: Write three Situation‑Task‑Action‑Result narratives highlighting analytical impact.

tasks.title: Mock interview with a peer
tasks.description: Conduct a 30‑minute technical interview focusing on case studies.

tasks.title: Reflect on feedback and improve
tasks.description: Summarize key takeaways from the mock interview and plan actions.

tasks.title: Network on LinkedIn data groups
tasks.description: Send connection requests to 5 data analysts and share a brief intro about your work.
